sections.title: Detail Mode
sections.description: Whether you are looking at the Low-Poly pieces you actually build and export with, or the real High-Poly game models laid over the top of them. Switching to High-Poly changes nothing about your map: the Low-Poly underneath is still what gets saved.

sections.title: Collision
sections.description: Inspect collision previews for scene objects.

sections.title: Map Context
sections.description: Build inside the real level instead of an empty grey box: the ground, the skyline, the buildings, the lighting and the effects the real place has. All of it is preview only: none of it is saved into your map or exported.

sections.title: Storage
sections.description: Reusable work prepared from your own Battlefield 6 installation. Clearing it does not delete your map; missing resources are prepared again when needed.

sections.title: Log
sections.description: A running account of what the plugin is doing, and anything that went wrong. If something breaks, save this and send it: it records which version, which level and which step, which a screenshot cannot.

detail_mode.label: Detail Mode
detail_mode.tip: Choose Low-Poly to see the SDK pieces you export. Choosing a higher detail mode builds the game preview automatically.

preview_selected.label: Preview selected
preview_selected.tip: Switch the selected pieces between SDK and high-poly previews.

prop_lighting.label: Prop Lighting
prop_lighting.tip: Preview the lights and illuminated surfaces carried by your placed props.

retry_skipped.label: Retry skipped
retry_skipped.tip: Retry objects that could not be built.

collisions.label: Collisions
collisions.tip: Show projected collision previews for scene objects.

isolate_selected.label: Isolate selected
isolate_selected.tip: Hide surrounding previews to inspect the selected collision shapes. Requires Collisions.

shape_outlines.label: Godot shape outlines
shape_outlines.tip: Show the editor's collision-shape outlines. Disabling them can reduce viewport work on busy maps.

collision_color.label: Color
collision_color.tip: Choose the collision overlay color and transparency.

collision_alpha.label: Alpha
collision_alpha.tip: Set how transparent the collision overlays are.

terrain.label: Extended Terrain
terrain.tip: Show the real ground surrounding the playable area. Preview only; excluded from your export.

backdrops.label: Backdrops
backdrops.tip: Show the distant skyline and scenery outside the playable area.

water.label: Water
water.tip: Show the water surfaces read from this level.

grass.label: Grass
grass.tip: Show ground clutter near your camera. Adds rendering work.

engine_tips.unreal: Show ground clutter from the level. Switching on a missing layer builds the scenery automatically.

objects.label: Original map objects
objects.tip: Show the level's original buildings, vehicles and clutter using game geometry.

fx.label: FX
fx.tip: Show the level effects, including smoke and distant effect cards.

fixture_lights.label: Map and prop lights
fixture_lights.tip: Preview fixture lights in the original map and placed props.

roads.label: Roads
roads.tip: Show road and ground decal layers.

contact_shading.label: Contact shading
contact_shading.tip: Darken the creases where surfaces meet. Costs rendering time.

shadows.label: Shadows
shadows.tip: Show shadows cast by the sun. Costs rendering time.

interior_light.label: Interior light
interior_light.tip: Adjust ambient light in areas sheltered from the sky.

ground_photo.label: Ground photo
ground_photo.tip: Adjust the strength of the level's aerial color raster on the terrain.

map_lights.label: Map lights
map_lights.tip: Show nearby street lights, signs and indoor fixtures from the original level.

variant.label: Variant
variant.tip: Preview an available game-mode layout for this map.

configure_shaders.label: Configure Shaders…
configure_shaders.tip: Adjust water, smoke and grass animation settings.

water_lab.label: Water Lab
water_lab.tip: Inspect and adjust water preview settings.

performance.label: Performance
performance.tip: Choose high-poly rendering and performance settings.

range.label: Range
range.tip: Set how far from the camera the preview scenery and placed details draw. Reduce this if flying becomes slow.

engine_tips.unreal: Set the distance at which placed objects switch between their SDK geometry and high-poly preview. Original scenery uses separate layer settings.

no_cull.label: No Cull
no_cull.tip: Draw preview objects at any distance. This can significantly increase rendering cost.
